mapper.select: select id from ${tableName} s where s.del_flag = 0 AND s.version=(SELECT max(t.version) FROM ${tableName} AS t WHERE t.del_flag = 0)
select id from ${tableName} s where s.del_flag = 0 AND s.version=(SELECT max(t.version) FROM ${tableName} AS t WHERE t.del_flag = 0 and t.valid = 1)
select ifnull(max(version), 1) from ${tableName} where del_flag = '0' and valid = '1' order by version desc;
